content.trans: 英语：正确，它很有趣，并且实际上在美国之外的大多数情况下，我们并没有那么常见地看到家长-教师会议。

content.text: So maybe if you're a parent you have attended a parent teacher conference or maybe when you're a kid your parents went to your parent teacher conference.
content.trans: 所以，如果你们是父母，你们可能已经参加了家长教师会议或者你们小时候的父母也去了您的家长教师会议。

content.text: And if you don't have teacher conference parent teacher conferences in your country what do you have?
content.trans: 如果你们不在自己的国家举行教师会议，你们在其他国家举行的家长会呢？

content.text: How do parents and teachers talk? Let us know our website is english.pl.com.
content.trans: 英语：如何父母和老师沟通？请告诉我们我们的网站是english.pl.com。

content.text: Alright we'll see you guys there. Bye.
content.trans: 好的，我已准备好。再见！
